dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, it's our last meeting. What would you like to see in our plan?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪts aʊər ˈlæst ˈmiːtɪŋ. ˈwʌt wʊd juː ˈlaɪk tə ˈsiː ɪn aʊər ˈplæn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd like to see poverty reduced. And I'd like to see more international cooperation.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈsiː ˈpɑːvərti rɪˈduːst. ənd aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈsiː ˈmɔːr ˌɪntərˈnæʃənəl koʊˌɑːpəˈreɪʃən.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Me too. I'd like to see rich countries working together with poorer ones.
dialogue.reading: miː ˈtuː. aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈsiː ˈrɪtʃ ˈkʌntriz ˈwɜːrkɪŋ təˈɡɛðər wɪð ˈpʊrər wʌnz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Exactly. And I'd like to see fair trade coffee sold in every supermarket.
dialogue.reading: ɪɡˈzæktli. ənd aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈsiː ˌfɛr ˌtreɪd ˈkɔːfi ˈsoʊld ɪn ˈɛvri ˈsuːpərmɑːrkɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Because then farmers in developing countries get a fair price for their coffee.
dialogue.reading: bɪˈkɔːz ˈðɛn ˈfɑːrmərz ɪn dɪˈvɛləpɪŋ ˈkʌntriz ˈɡɛt ə ˈfɛr ˈpraɪs fər ðɛr ˈkɔːfi.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And what about war? It's one of the biggest causes of hunger.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈwɔːr? ɪts ˈwʌn əv ðə ˈbɪɡɪst ˈkɔːzɪz əv ˈhʌŋɡər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's true. Without peace, nothing else is possible.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtruː. wɪˈðaʊt ˈpiːs, ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈɛls ɪz ˈpɑːsəbəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So what would you like to see happen?
dialogue.reading: soʊ ˈwʌt wʊd juː ˈlaɪk tə ˈsiː ˈhæpən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd like to see more money spent on peace, not on war.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈsiː ˈmɔːr ˈmʌni ˈspɛnt ɑːn ˈpiːs, ˈnɑːt ɑːn ˈwɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Do you think we'll ever see a world without war?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈθɪŋk wiːl ˈɛvər ˈsiː ə ˈwɜːrld wɪˈðaʊt ˈwɔːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe not soon. But I'd like to see us try.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi ˈnɑːt ˈsuːn. bʌt aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈsiː ʌs ˈtraɪ.
